title: Příprava, zajištění a organizace MÁJOVÉ KONFERENCE 2027
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je poskytnutí kompletních služeb a servisu spojených s přípravou, zajištěním a organizací Májové konference (dále jen „konference“), která se uskuteční v květnu 2027 v konferenčních prostorech v Brně, a s ní souvisejícího společenského večera v prostorech Jižní terasy, Východní terasy, Královské kaple a Hranolové věže hradu Špilberk (dále jen „Galavečer“). Předmětem veřejné zakázky je zejména: ■ zajištění elektronické registrace účastníků konference (předpokládaný počet – 200 osob), výběr účastnického konferenčního poplatku; ■ zajištění konferenčních prostor, včetně cateringových služeb; ■ ubytovací služby pro vybrané přednášející (předpokládaný počet – 20 přednášejících ve 20 samostatných pokojích); ■ zprostředkování ubytovacích služeb pro účastníky konference – samoplátce (předpokládaný počet – 50 dvoulůžkových pokojů); ■ zajištění min 15 bezplatných parkovacích míst pro vybrané přednášející a hosty; ■ organizace konference, zajištění konferenčních materiálů; ■ příprava a zajištění prostoru pro konání Galavečera; ■ zajištění prohlídky prostor hradu Špilberk pro vybrané účastníky konference; ■ cateringové služby pro Galavečer; ■ zajištění živého hudebního doprovodu přiměřeného společenskému charakteru Galavečera; ■ pořízení fotodokumentace. Zadavatel si vyhrazuje možnost na uplatnění vyhrazené změny závazku dle § 100 odst. 3 zákona č. 134/2016 Sb., o zadávání veřejných zakázek, ve znění pozdějších předpisů, na poskytnutí nových služeb spočívajících v opakování obdobných služeb jako v této veřejné zakázce. Minimální požadavky na předmět veřejné zakázky, včetně vyhrazené změny závazku, jsou vymezeny technickými, obchodními a jinými smluvními podmínkami, které jsou specifikovány ve Výzvě k podání nabídek ze dne 30. 9. 2026 a jejich přílohách.

title: Udbud af kontrakt vedr. morskørsel til dansk politi
description: Dansk Politi udbyder kontrakt vedr. morskørsel. Delt op i fem (5) delaftaler: Delaftale 1: Morskørsel til Nordjyllands- og Midt- og Vestjyllands Politi Delaftale 2: Morskørsel til Østjyllands-, Sydøstjyllands- og Syd- og Sønderjyllands Politi Delaftale 3: Morskørsel til Fyns, Midt- og Vestsjællands og Sydsjælland og Lolland-Falsters Politi Delaftale 4: Morskørsel til Nordsjællands-, Københavns Vestegns- og Københavns Politi Delaftale 5: Morskørsel til Bornholms Politi Dansk politi har behov for kørsel af afdøde personer, der er erklæret for døde, og hvor dødsfaldet er omfattet af indberetningspligten jf. Sundhedslovens § 179, og hvor afdøde ikke ligger til offentligt skue. Kørslen omfatter to typer af kørsler, der skal udføres døgnet- og året rundt: 1. Almindelig morskørsel o Kørsel af afdøde fra opsamlingssted til et af politiets nærmere angivne steder. Dette kan eksempelvis være et kapel, et sygehus eller et retsmedicinsk institut, hvor der skal udføres et retslægeligt ligsyn. 2. Intern kørsel Udgangspunktet for Intern morskørsel er, at de kan planlægges mellem kunden og leverandøren. Intern kørsel bliver relevant i de situationer: o Hvor afdøde forud for dødens konstatering har været indbragt med ambulance til sygehus. Denne kørsel kan foregå mellem sygehus og kapel o Hvor der ved det retslægelige tilsyn vurderes, at der skal foretages obduktion. Denne kørsel består af to kørsler hhv. til retsmedicinsk institut og retur til udgangspunktet.

title: Udbud af tre rammeaftaler vedrørende indkøb af træningsudstyr
description: Team Danmarks organisation består af en administrerende direktør, en sportsdirektør og ca. 50 medarbejdere, som arbejder inden for syv sportsfaglige områder: Sportsligt samarbejde, karriere- og talentudvikling, sportsmedicin, sportsfysiologi, analyse, ernæring og psykologi. Team Danmarks vision er at skabe de bedst mulige vilkår og rammer for dansk eliteidræt og for de enkelte atleter. At udvikle eliteidræt i verdensklasse handler således for Team Danmark om at sikre en rød tråd gennem atletens rejse – fra klubben, hvor det hele starter, hele vejen til toppen af medaljeskamlen og videre til livet efter sportskarrieren. Det handler både om mennesker og medaljer. For at kunne udleve denne vision er det afgørende, at Team Danmarks atleter og trænere har adgang til træningsudstyr af høj kvalitet, der understøtter optimal træning, restitution og præstation på højeste internationale niveau. Team Danmark ønsker således med dette udbud at indkøbe træningsudstyr, som netop skal bidrage til at sikre de danske eliteatleter de bedst mulige fysiske rammer og vilkår for at udvikle og udleve deres fulde potentiale inden for et samlet budget på 8 mio. kr. ekskl. moms. På denne baggrund udbyder Team Danmark følgende tre ikke eksklusive delkontrakter, der alle udbydes som rammeaftaler for en 4-årig periode, men hvor den leverandør, der tildeles den enkelte delkontrakt, er garanteret et engangsindkøb, der foretages af Team Danmark umiddelbart efter indgåelsen af den relevante delkontrakt, og hvor det træningsudstyr, der omfattes af engangsindkøbet, skal leveres til Team Danmark senest i løbet af april 2027: (i) Delkontrakt A, der vedrører et engangsindkøb af cardioudstyr samt løbende indkøb af cardioudstyr med et maksimumbeløb på i alt 2,5 mio. kr. ekskl. moms (ii) Delkontrakt B, der vedrører et engangsindkøb af træningsmaskiner samt løbende indkøb af træningsmaskiner med et maksimumbeløb på i alt 2,5 mio. kr. ekskl. moms (iii) Delkontrakt C, der vedrører et engangsindkøb af stænger og frivægte samt løbende indkøb af stænger og frivægter med et maksimumbeløb på i alt 3 mio. kr. ekskl. moms. Det engangsindkøb, som Team Danmark forpligter sig til at foretage umiddelbart efter indgåelsen af den relevante delkontrakt, er nærmere defineret i tilbudslisten. Udover engangsindkøbet har Team Danmark ikke aftagepligt på hverken delkontrakt A, delkontrakt B eller delkontrakt C. Det forventet indkøbsbehov over de næste fire år er indsat i tilbudslisten til brug for evalueringen. Dette forventede indkøbsbehov er alene vejledende og baseret på Team Danmarks skøn over det forventede indkøb og er således ikke bindende for Team Danmark. Dette betyder, at de(n) leverandør, der tildeles delkontrakt A og/eller delkontrakt B eller delkontrakt C, ikke kan gøre krav gældende mod Team Danmark, hvis Team Danmarks indkøbsbehov viser sig at være mindre end det, der er anført i tilbudslisten. Ligeledes skal leverandøren på hver delaftale kunne levere større mængder, end hvad der fremgår af det estimerede indkøb, idet der i alle tre delkontrakter er en bestemmelse om, at Team Danmark er berettiget til at forhøje delkontrakternes ramme med 50 % indtil seks måneder før delkontrakternes indkøbsperiodes udløb Opdelingen i tre delkontrakter er begrundet i, at markedet for henholdsvis cardio-udstyr (delkontrakt A), træningsmaskiner (delkontrakt B) samt stænger og frivægte (delkontrakt C) i vidt omfang består af forskellige og til dels specialiserede leverandører, hvorfor en opdeling giver flere virksomheder, herunder mindre og mere specialiserede leverandører, mulighed for at afgive tilbud på den eller de delkontrakter, der matcher deres forretningsområde. Opdelingen understøtter dermed konkurrencen om den enkelte delkontrakt og øger sandsynligheden for, at Team Danmark modtager konkurrencedygtige tilbud på samtlige tre produktkategorier. Tilbudsgiver kan afgive tilbud på alle delkontrakter. En tilbudsgiver kan tildeles delkontrakt A og delkontrakt B, men kan ikke samtidig tildeles delkontrakt C. Den tilbudsgiver, der tildeles delkontrakt C, kan således alene tildeles denne delkontrakt. Dette betyder, at tilbudsgiver, hvis tilbudsgiver tildeles delkontrakt C, ikke kan tildeles delkontrakt A og/eller delkontrakt B. Tildeles tilbudsgiver delkontrakt A, kan tilbudsgiver godt blive tildelt delkontrakt B. Tilsvarende kan tilbudsgiver godt blive tildelt delkontrakt B, hvis tilbudsgiver tildeles delkontrakt A. Delkontrakterne forventes at træde i kraft ved kontraktunderskrivelse og løber herefter i 48 måneder. De krav, der stilles til det træningsudstyr, der er omfattet af henholdsvis delkontrakt A, delkontrakt B og delkontrakt C, er nærmere beskrevet i kravsspecifikationen, der er vedlagt som en del af udbudsmaterialet. Tilbudsgiver skal stille en række vareprøver til rådighed for Team Danmark. De vareprøver, som tilbudsgiver skal stille til rådighed for Team Danmark, er markeret med grøn i tilbudslisten, der indgår som en del af det samlede udbudsmateriale. Udbuddet gennemføres elektronisk ved brug af udbudsportalen www.udbuddet.dk. Tilbudsgiver skal derfor oprettes som licenshaver hos www.udbuddet.dk. Oprettelse kan ske uden omkostning. Spørgsmål vedrørende www.udbuddet.dk skal stilles direkte til www.udbuddet.dk via support-funktionen, der kan træffes via telefon +45 7022 7007 Der ydes ikke vederlag for tilbudsgivernes deltagelse i udbudsprocessen. Hvis der nogetsteds i kravsspecifikationen eller udbudsmaterialet i øvrigt er henvist til standarder, skal enhver henvisning forstås som en henvisning til den nævnte standard eller tilsvarende. Opfylder tilbudsgiver ikke den nævnte standard, men tilsvarende, skal tilbudsgiver i tilbuddet dokumentere, at den tilbudte løsning på de relevante parametre er tilsvarende. I det tilfælde tilbudsgiverne fremsætter ønske om det, afholder Ordregiver gerne et infomøde forud for tilbudsfristen. Tilbudsgiverne opfordres i så fald til at tilkendegive ønsket herom på udbudsportalen.

Ireland – Architectural design services – Tipperary County Council Procurement of Single-Party Framework Agreement for Architect-Led Integrated Design Team Consultancy Services for Clonmel, Co. Tipperary
description: Tipperary County Council Procurement of Single-Party Framework Agreement for Architect-Led Integrated Design Team Consultancy Services for Clonmel, Co. Tipperary. Tipperary County Council is undertaking a competitive tendering process for the establishment of a Single-Party Framework Agreement for Architect-Led Integrated Multi-Disciplinary Consultancy Services for Public Realm, Landscape and Building Upgrade Projects in Clonmel, Co. Tipperary. The Framework Agreement will require the successful Consultant to provide, either directly or through its proposed multi-disciplinary team, all of the following services: 1. Architectural Services – Public Realm 2. Conservation Architectural Services 3. Landscape Architectural Services 4. Civil and Structural Engineering Services 5. Quantity Surveying Services 6. Project Management Services 7. Project Supervisor Design Process (PSDP) Services 8. Employer’s Representative Services 9. Public Liaison / Stakeholder Engagement Services 10. Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Services 11. Planning Services 12. Archaeological Services 13. Fire Engineering Services Only Applicants capable of providing all of the above disciplines and associated specialist expertise, whether in-house, through subcontractors or as part of a grouping/consortium, will be considered. This competition will be conducted using a restricted procedure. At Stage 1, Applicants will be assessed against the suitability and selection criteria set out in the Suitability Assessment Questionnaire. It is intended that the five highest-scoring Applicants, subject to a sufficient number meeting all minimum requirements and rules for selection, will be invited to participate in Stage 2. At Stage 2, shortlisted Applicants will be issued with the Invitation to Tender and associated tender documentation. Tenders will be evaluated in accordance with the award criteria and weightings set out in the Invitation to Tender. The highest-ranked compliant Tenderer will be appointed to the Single-Party Framework Agreement and will also be awarded the Initial Contract. The Initial Contract will relate to the further development and delivery of public realm and associated projects in Clonmel. Clonmel Town Centre requires a significant streetscape and public realm upgrade. A design previously received Part VIII approval; however, the design now requires further development, amendment and coordination to reflect the current project scope and available funding and to bring the project through detailed design, tender, construction and handover stages. Tipperary County Council has also acquired a protected structure for which design development and a Part VIII planning process will be required. The Architect-Led Design Team may therefore be required to deliver a combination of public realm, landscape, civil engineering and building upgrade works, including works to protected and heritage structures. The Architect will act as Lead Consultant and will be responsible for coordinating and managing the full multi-disciplinary design team, programme, cost and delivery of the projects. During the construction stage, the Design Team will be required to provide ongoing technical support, respond to queries arising on site and advise on proposed variations and other matters affecting the delivery of the works. Projects arising under the Framework Agreement are anticipated to be funded, in whole or in part, through the Towns and Cities Regeneration Investment Fund (TCRIF) and/or other available funding programmes. Please note that an ITT is not required for this stage of the tender process.

buyer: Hull University Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust
title: Insourced Breast USC One-Stop Triple Assessment and Symptomatic Breast Radiology
description:
Hull University Hospitals NHS Trust (HUTH) on behalf of the Humber Health Partnership (HHP) plan to work in partnership with an Independent Sector (IS) Provider to facilitate provision of additional “one-stop” outpatient clinic capacity within the Breast Urgent Suspected Cancer (USC) pathway, to proactively manage capacity to maintain the delivery of the Cancer Faster Diagnostic Standard during periods where there is a demand vs capacity imbalance, and symptomatic breast radiology clinic support.

The “One-Stop Triple Assessment Clinic" is a new-patient outpatient clinic that delivers a triple diagnostic assessment in the form of:
• Clinical assessment
• Mammography and/or ultrasound imaging
• Fine needle aspiration or core biopsy

The IS provider will provide a full team of appropriately qualified and experienced workforce for each Breast USC “one-stop” triple assessment outpatient clinic (1 at Castle Hill Hospital and 1 at Diana Princess of Wales Hospital), namely for each site:
• 1 x Breast surgery clinician
• 1 x Radiology clinician
• 1 x Radiographer
• 1 x Radiology Assistant (RDA)
• 1 x Appropriate Breast Healthcare Assistant (HCA)
• 1 x Registered Nurse (RN) Support
Each clinic will be an all-day 25 patient session, utilising both AM and PM clinics. Clinics are expected to be delivered between 08:00 to 18:00 only. The sessions will be arranged initially over the weekends with options to be explored for weekday sessions in the future if required.

The "Symptomatic Breast Radiology Clinic Support" requires the provision of an appropriately qualified and experienced consultant radiologist to support weekday activity. This comprises the imaging component of triple assessment for symptomatic breast imaging and will include reporting mammograms / digital tomosynthesis, ultrasound of breast and axilla with biopsy as required and marker placement. Post marker check mammograms will also need reporting where appropriate. This will focus on patients that are referred into the breast symptomatic service on the Consultant led pathway. The requirement is initially for Wednesday & Thursday clinics at Castle Hill Hospital.

The contract is expected to run with an initial term from 2nd January to the end of March 2027, with options to extend for up to another 12 months subject to demand and internal approvals.

Please refer to the full service specifications and other ITT Documents for further details.

Ebenso soll die Haustechnik komplett erneuert und an die Anforderungen an Nachhaltigkeit und Komfort angepasst werden. Das Bestandsgebäude wurde ca. 1975 errichtet und umfasst ein Kellergeschoss und Erdgeschoss. Über die Jahre wurden an diesem Bestandsbau diverse Änderungen vorgenommen und mehrere Erweiterungen angebaut, zuletzt 2017. Es werden einzelne Gebäudeteile und der Innenausbau inkl. Technik rückgebaut. Hierfür sind Sicherungsmaßnahmen notwendig. Das bestehende Tragwerk des ursprünglichen Gebäudes hat sich als nicht ausreichend tragfähig herausgestellt. Im Untergeschoss müssen Fundamente unterfangen werden und neue Fundamente für neue Wände erstellt werden. Nach den Rückbauarbeiten werden neue Mauerwerks- und Stahlbetonwände und Stahlbetondecken hergestellt. Die Grundleitungen werden rückgebaut und neu verlegt. Seitlich am Gebäude werden Abgrabungen hergestellt, mit mehreren Stützwänden. Die Kindertagesstätte hat nach ihrer Sanierung eine BGF von ca. 2500 m² und einen BRI von ca. 8700 m³. Es werden Rohbau-, Erdbau- und Entwässerungs- und Abbrucharbeiten in folgendem Umfang ausgeschrieben: Abbrucharbeiten: ca. 1700 m² Bodenaufbau, inkl. title: Peltisepäntöiden puitejärjestely
description: Peltisepäntöiden puitejärjestely Museovirasto, Suomenlinnan hoitokunta -osasto ("Hankintayksikkö") kilpailuttaa Suomenlinnan ja Seurasaaren kiinteistöjen peltisepäntyöt ("Palvelu"). Tavoitteena on perustaa puitesopimus, jonka kautta Hankintayksiköllä on mahdollista hankkia Palveluita tarpeidensa mukaisesti. Palvelua teetetään Hankintayksikön hallinnoimissa rakennuksissa, joissa sijaitsee toimitiloja, työtiloja, asuntoja sekä museorakennuksia. Palvelussa kiinnitetään erityistä huomiota kohteen kulttuurihistoriallisiin arvoihin, ominaispiirteisiin, materiaaleihin ja vanhoihin rakennustapoihin. Töitä tehdään eri aikakausina rakennetuissa kohteissa, ja niitä tehdään ympärivuotisesti. Palveluihin kuuluvat esimerkiksi: • vesikatteiden peltityöt kuten katepeltien asennukset ja saumaukset • syöksytorvet ja räystäskourut • ikkunapellitykset sekä hormien ja läpivientien peltiasennukset • peltikatteiden tiivistyskorjaukset ja kattoturvatuotteiden asennukset. Tarjoaja voi toimia toimeksiannoissa joko päätoteuttajana tai sivu-urakoitsijana. Työkohteet ovat vaihtelevia ja osa kohteista on hyvin pieniä. Puitejärjestelyn perusteella tehtävät työt ovat pääsääntöisesti tuntihintaperusteisena laskutustyönä tehtäviä erilaisia peltisepäntöitä. Töitä voidaan teettää myös erilaisilla urakkamuodoilla. Työnaikainen dokumentointi ja valokuvaus sisältyvät kaikkiin töihin. Valituilla toimittajilla on mahdollisuus käyttää Hankintayksikön järjestämiä, yhteyskäytössä olevia henkilöstötiloja Suomenlinnassa puitesopimuksen mukaisten toimeksiantojen aikana. Tiloista peritään vuokraa, joka sovitaan erikseen. Seurasaaressa ei ole yhteiskäyttöisiä henkilöstötiloja. Hankinnan kohde on esitelty tarkemmin jäljempänä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. PUITEJÄRJESTELY Hankinnan tuloksena perustetaan puitejärjestely. Kokonaistaloudellisen edullisuuden valintaperuste on paras hinta-laatusuhde, minkä perusteella Hankintayksikkö valitsee neljä (4) parhaat pisteet saanutta palveluntuottajaa, ellei kelpoisuusehdot täyttäviä tarjoajia tai hyväksyttäviä tarjouksia ole vähemmän. Mikäli hyväksyttäviä tarjouksia vastaanotetaan vähemmän kuin edellä on esitetty, valitsee Hankintayksikkö kaikki tarjoajat automaattisesti mukaan puitejärjestelyyn, mikäli kaikki Hankintayksikön tarjoajalle ja sen tarjoamille palveluille asetetut vaatimukset täyttyvät. Sopimuskausi alkaa puitesopimuksen (hankintasopimuksen) allekirjoittamisesta ja jatkuu kolme (3) vuotta). Lisäksi Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden jatkaa sopimuskautta yhden (1) vuoden optiokaudella. Yksittäiset tilaukset puitejärjestelyn sisällä tehdään kevennetyn kilpailutuksen perusteella. Puitejärjestelystä tehdyn sopimuksen ehtoja ja sisältöä noudatetaan kaikissa Hankintayksikön ja puitejärjestelyyn valitun tarjoajan välisissä suhteissa. Puitejärjestelyyn perustuva toimeksianto voidaan tehdä vain puitesopimuksen voimassaoloaikana. Tarjoajan on otettava huomioon, että puitejärjestelyyn perustuvia toimeksiantoja toteutetaan Hankintayksikön päättämän aikataulun mukaisesti, jolloin toimeksiannot eivät välttämättä jakaudu tasaisesti sopimuskauden ajalle. Hankintayksikkö hankkii Palveluita omien tarpeidensa mukaisesti, eikä Hankintayksikkö sitoudu vähimmäisostomääriin. Puitesopimus ei anna valituille toimittajille yksinoikeutta hankittavien palveluiden toimittamiseen.,

title: Belgium – Motorcycles, bicycles and sidecars – Raamcontract fietsleasing
description: skeyes a l'intention de conclure un contrat-cadre avec une société de leasing qui offre la possibilité de souscrire un contrat de leasing de vélos aux membres du personnel selon les principes de l’échange de salaires (bruts). Le nombre de vélos en leasing à livrer dépendra du succès rencontré par cette opportunité auprès des membres du personnel. La taille de ce marché est estimée à 300 vélos sur la durée totale du marché (à titre indicatif). skeyes vise à minimiser la charge administrative, tant pour elle-même que pour les employés qui souhaitent utiliser le système de leasing de vélos. skeyes souhaite conclure un contrat-cadre avec un (1) contractant. Le contrat-cadre aura une durée initiale de deux (2) ans (renouvelable pour un (1) an). Durant cette période, l’employé aura la possibilité de commander un vélo au travers de ce contrat-cadre. La durée du leasing pourra s’étendre au-delà de la durée du contrat- cadre. Il s’agit d’un contrat-cadre où les conditions et les dispositions des prestations de service à respecter lors de l’exécution des marchés subséquents (les contrats individuels pour les employés) seront convenues. La société de leasing n'a aucune exclusivité et il n'y a aucune obligation d'achat ni obligation de volume pour skeyes. La durée des leasings individuels est flexible avec un maximum de trente-six (36) mois. skeyes souhaite fournir une gamme complète et qualitative de vélos à ses employés. À cette fin, le contrat-cadre comprend entre autres les « types » de vélos suivants : • vélo classique électrique • vélo porteur électrique • vélo électrique pliant • vélo à pédalage rapide (speed pedelec) • vélo classique non électrique • mountainbike non-électrique • mountainbike électrique • vélo de route non-électrique • vélo de route électrique • gravel bike (vélo de gravier)

title: Finland – Computer equipment and supplies – ICT laitteiden ja tarvikkeiden dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä
description: Tämän dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohteena ovat Tilaajien tarvitsemat Tuotteet, jotka koostuvat ICT-laitteista ja tarvikkeista sekä Tuotteisiin liittyvät Palvelut. Hankinnan kohteena ovat seuraavat tuoteryhmät Perustyöasemat Tehotyöasemat Perusnäytöt Diagnostiset näytöt Erillisnäytöt Kannettavat tietokoneet Tulostimet (mustavalkoiset + värilliset) Monitoimilaitteet (mustavalkoiset + värilliset) Tarra-, potilasranneke- ja korttitulostimet Tulostusmateriaalit ja -tarvikkeet myös olemassa oleviin tulostuslaitteisiin Hoitoalueen työasemat, tehotyöasemat, paneeli-PC:t ja akkupaneeli-PC:t, näytöt ja laitevaunut Laitevaunut ja telineet iOS- ja Android-tablet-tietokoneet PDA-laitteet Viivakoodinlukijat Ruggeroidut laitteet: kannettavat tietokoneet, PDA-laitteet, tabletit, tulostimet Tietoliikenneverkon laitteet: lähiverkon (LAN JA WLAN) laitteet, laajaverkon (WAN) laitteet ja konesaliverkon laitteet sekä tietoturvalaitteet Paikalliset (On-Premises) palvelimet ja tallennusratkaisut: Esimerkiksi: Yhteiskäyttöiset palvelintietokoneet, toimipistekohtaiset pienet palvelimet, tietoturvaan ja valvontaan liittyvät palvelimet, erikoiskäyttöön tarkoitetut tehokkaat palvelimet Esimerkiksi: Laitteet keskitettyyn tiedon tallennukseen, palvelimiin sisältyvä tallennus, varmuuskopiointilaitteet Lisälaitteet Esimerkiksi hiiret, näppäimistöt ja muut ohjaimet, telakat, toimikortinlukijat, ulkoiset asemat ja kiintolevyt, kuulokkeet ja kaiuttimet, web-kamerat. Lisätarvikkeet Esimerkiksi kaapelit, lisävirtalähteet, adapterit, näyttövarret ja -telineet, tietosuoja- ja tietoturvakalvot sekä tietokoneille tarkoitetut suojapussit, laukut, tietokoneiden säilyttämiseen ja lataamiseen liittyvät ratkaisut. Tietoliikennelaitteisiin kiinteästi liittyvät muut tuotteet (kuten esimerkiksi laitteiden käyttöön liittyvät lisenssit, lisätarvikkeet, tietoliikenneverkon laitteiden yhteyteen hankittavat muut laitteet, kuten varavoimalaitteet ja ohjelmistot/ohjelmistojen käyttöoikeudet) Palvelimiin ja tallennusratkaisuihin kiinteästi liittyvät muut tuotteet (kuten esimerkiksi laitteiden käyttöön liittyvät lisenssit, lisätarvikkeet, laitteiden yhteyteen hankittavat muut laitteet, kuten varavoimalaitteet ja ohjelmistot/ohjelmistojen käyttöoikeudet) Lisäksi Tilaajat voivat hankkia muita vastaavia ICT-laitteita ja tarvikkeita. Palvelut: Hankinnan kohteena ovat seuraavat Tuotteisiin ja niiden asennukseen ja muuhun käyttövalmiuteen saattamiseen liittyvät Palvelut sekä Tuotteisiin liittyvät lisäpalvelut, kuten toimitus-, huolto-, asennus-, asiantuntija- ja konsulttipalvelut Edellä mainitusta poiketen vanhan laitteen noutopalvelu, käytettyjen laitteiden välivarastopalvelu, kierrätyspalvelu, tietoturvallinen tuhoamispalvelu ja asiantuntijapalveluita voidaan kuitenkin hankkia myös muun sopimuksen perusteella hankittuun laitteeseen. Esimerkkejä Tuotteisiin liittyvistä Palveluista: Verkkokauppa (tilausportaali). Verkkokauppa Tuotteiden ja Palveluiden tilaamiseen. Puskurivarastopalvelu sovittujen Tuotteita varastointiin Tilaajan tarpeita varten. Tuotteiden Esiasennuspalvelu esimerkiksi käyttöjärjestelmän ja ohjelmistojen asentamiseen hankittuun Tuotteeseen. Tuotteen purkaminen pakkauksesta -palvelu, jossa Toimittaja purkaa laitteen mahdollisista pakkauksista ja asettaa laitteen lopulliseen asennuskohteeseen tai muuhun Tilaajan ilmoittamaan paikkaan. Asennuspalvelu, jossa Toimittaja purkaa Tuotteet mahdollisista pakkauksista, asentaa ne Tilaajan kanssa sovittuun kohteeseen, kytkee laitteiston sähkö- ja tietoliikenneverkkoon ja testaa sekä varmistaa laitteiston toimivuuden. Vanhan laitteen noutopalvelu, jossa Toimittaja noutaa käytöstä poistettavan laitteen Tilaajalta ja vastaa laitteen kierrättämisestä. Kierrätyspalvelu, jossa Toimittaja vastaa laitteen kierrättämisestä keskitetyssä pisteessä, johon Tilaaja toimittaa käytöstä poistettavan Tuotteen. Tietoturvallinen tuhoamispalvelu, jossa Toimittaja tuhoaa laitteiden tallennuskomponenttien sisältämät tiedot tietoturvallisesti ja luotettavasti. Tietoliikennelaitteiden, palvelinlaitteiden ja varmistuslaitteiden huolto- ja ylläpitopalvelu, joka sisältää laitteen huolto- ja ylläpitopalvelun, joka sisältää esim. ohjelmistojen päivitysoikeuden, teknisen tuen vikatilanteissa, varalaitepalvelun tai vaihtolaitetakuun tai korjausaikapalvelun. Tietoliikennelaitteiden, palvelinlaitteiden ja varmistuslaitteiden ohjelmistojen päivityspalvelu, joka sisältää laitteen ohjelmistojen päivitysoikeuden sisältyen laitteiden hankintahintaan koko laitteen elinkaaren ajan ilman lisähintaa. Tietoliikennelaitteiden, palvelinlaitteiden ja varmistuslaitteiden valvonta- ja hallintapalvelu, joka sisältää laitteiden valvontapalvelua ja hallintapalvelua. Asiantuntijapalvelut sisältävät hankinnan kohteena oleviin laitteisiin liittyviä asiantuntijapalveluita Toimittajalta. Tuotteiden hankinta palvelulaitteina: Palvelulaitteet ovat palvelua, jossa Tilaaja hankkii laitteen ja siihen liittyvät palvelut Toimittajalta kokonaispalveluna (palvelulaite) sovituksi määräajaksi. Laitteiden omistusoikeus säilyy Toimittajalla, ellei Tilaaja lunasta niitä palvelun päättyessä. Kaikki edellä kuvatut Palvelut ovat esimerkkejä ja kulloinkin Tilaajan tarvitsemat Palvelut määritellään sisäisten kilpailutusten tarjouspyynnöissä. Palveluiden sisältö, määrä, toimitus ajat ja muut vastaavat tiedot täsmentyvät sisäisissä kilpailutuksissa. Tuotteisiin liittyviä Palveluita ei voida hankkia erikseen, vaan niiden tulee liittyä Tilaajan hankintasopimuksen perusteella hankkimaan Tuotteeseen.

Kierrätyspalvelu, jossa Toimittaja vastaa laitteen kierrättämisestä keskitetyssä pisteessä, johon Tilaaja toimittaa käytöstä poistettavan Tuotteen. Tietoturvallinen tuhoamispalvelu, jossa Toimittaja tuhoaa laitteiden tallennuskomponenttien sisältämät tiedot tietoturvallisesti ja luotettavasti. Tietoliikennelaitteiden, palvelinlaitteiden ja varmistuslaitteiden huolto- ja ylläpitopalvelu, joka sisältää laitteen huolto- ja ylläpitopalvelun, joka sisältää esim. ohjelmistojen päivitysoikeuden, teknisen tuen vikatilanteissa, varalaitepalvelun tai vaihtolaitetakuun tai korjausaikapalvelun. Tietoliikennelaitteiden, palvelinlaitteiden ja varmistuslaitteiden ohjelmistojen päivityspalvelu, joka sisältää laitteen ohjelmistojen päivitysoikeuden sisältyen laitteiden hankintahintaan koko laitteen elinkaaren ajan ilman lisähintaa. Tietoliikennelaitteiden, palvelinlaitteiden ja varmistuslaitteiden valvonta- ja hallintapalvelu, joka sisältää laitteiden valvontapalvelua ja hallintapalvelua. Asiantuntijapalvelut sisältävät hankinnan kohteena oleviin laitteisiin liittyviä asiantuntijapalveluita Toimittajalta. Tuotteiden hankinta palvelulaitteina: Palvelulaitteet ovat palvelua, jossa Tilaaja hankkii laitteen ja siihen liittyvät palvelut Toimittajalta kokonaispalveluna (palvelulaite) sovituksi määräajaksi. Laitteiden omistusoikeus säilyy Toimittajalla, ellei Tilaaja lunasta niitä palvelun päättyessä. Kaikki edellä kuvatut Palvelut ovat esimerkkejä ja kulloinkin Tilaajan tarvitsemat Palvelut määritellään sisäisten kilpailutusten tarjouspyynnöissä. Palveluiden sisältö, määrä, toimitus ajat ja muut vastaavat tiedot täsmentyvät sisäisissä kilpailutuksissa. Tuotteisiin liittyviä Palveluita ei voida hankkia erikseen, vaan niiden tulee liittyä Tilaajan hankintasopimuksen perusteella hankkimaan Tuotteeseen.

title: 6515--AESCULAP STAINLESS STEEL SURGICAL INSTRUMENTS
description: This Sources Sought Notice is for the Fredericksburg HCC to determine sources for a comprehensive package of brand name or equal Aesculap Stainless-Steel Surgical Instruments to support a wide range of surgical specialties at the Fredericksburg VA Health Care Center. The instruments consists of Surgical Instrument Containers with Lids, Baskets for Surgical Instruments inside containers with lids, Silicone Mats/Cushioning Pads for Surgical Instruments placed in the containers with lids, Snap On ID Tags for inside Surgical Instrument Containers, Identification Labels to be etched with Tray Names for the Surgical Instrument and Containers, and Instrument Stringers. This is a SOURCES SOUGHT announcement only. The purpose of this notice is to conduct market research and obtain information from qualified businesses. This is not a request for bids, quotes, or proposals. All responsible sources must submit a capability statement addressing their capabilities, capacity, place of manufacture, and location which shall be considered by the agency. � This notice shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government to ultimately award a contract, nor does it restrict the Government to a particular acquisition approach. All information submitted in response to this announcement is voluntary; the Government will not pay for information requested nor will it compensate any respondent for any cost incurred in developing information provided to the Government. � Interested parties submitting a response to this inquiry must include the following information: Capability statement Name and address of company NAICS Code SAM.gov UEI number Business size (large or small) Place of manufacture Identify applicable socioeconomic categories (SDVOSB/VOSB etc.) any pertinent information which demonstrates the firm s ability to meet the above requirement An authorized distributor letter if the interested party is not the manufacturer Identify all the products on any schedule and provide the contract number. Identify open market products All responses shall be submitted no later than Monday, 10/24/2026, by 10:00 AM EST. Responses shall be emailed to: Tiara.White@va.gov. When replying, please include Sources Sought 36C24626Q0993 to ensure the email is reviewed in a timely manner.

title: Kulunvalvontajärjestelmän ja siihen liittyvien palveluiden hankinta
description: Kulunvalvontajärjestelmän ja siihen liittyvien palveluiden hankinta Espoon kaupunki, Espoon Elä ja Asu Oy, Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän Uimahalli, Kiinteistö Oy Tapiolan Louhi ja Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Keskuskeittiö (myöhemmin myös Tilaaja) pyytävät tarjouksia Kulunvalvontajärjestelmän ja siihen liittyvien palveluiden hankinnasta. Hankinnan kohteena on Espoon kaupungin sekä Espoon Elä ja Asu Oy:n, Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän Uimahallin, Kiinteistö Oy Tapiolan Louhen ja Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Keskuskeittiön hallinnoimissa rakennuksissa sijaitsevien Esmikko-kulunvalvontajärjestelmien korvaaminen uudella kulunvalvontajärjestelmällä. Lisäksi hankintaan sisältyy Tilaajan käytössä olevan Abloy OS -kulunvalvontajärjestelmän huolto- ja ylläpitopalvelut. Kohteet sijaitsevat Espoon kaupungin alueella. Hankinnan ennakoitu kokonaisarvo ilman arvonlisäveroa 1 610 000 euroa (alv. 0 %) joka jakautuu seuraavasti: Espoon kaupunki 1 410 000 euroa Espoon Elä ja Asu Oy 50 000 euroa Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän uimahalli 50 000 euroa Kiinteistö Oy Tapiolan Louhi 50 000 euroa Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Keskuskeittiö 50 000 euroa Toimittajan Palvelun tuottamiseen käyttämien henkilöiden tulee olla suorassa työsuhteessa Toimittajaan pois lukien kaapelointityöt. Kilpailutuksen perusteella muodostetaan puitejärjestely, johon valitaan enintään neljä (4) Toimittajaa etusijajärjestyksessä. Puitejärjestelyn tarkempi kuvaus on liitteellä "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". Vaihtoehtoisia tarjouksia ei hyväksytä. description: Sources Sought: Euclid Creek Fishway Construction; W912P425X11LG SOURCES SOUGHT DESCRIPTION: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE, RELEASED PURSUANT TO FEDERAL ACQUISITION REGULATION (FAR) PART 10: MARKET RESEARCH. By way of this Market Survey/Sources Sought Notice, the USACE-Buffalo District intends to determine the extent of firms that are engaged in providing the services described hereunder for the Euclid Creek Fishway. This Sources Sought Notice is issued solely for informational, market research, and planning purposes only and does not commit the government to any further contract actions, i.e., solicitation and/or contract. Respondents are advised that the United States Government will not pay for any information or administrative cost incurred in responding to this Sources Sought Notice. Not responding to this Sources Sought Notice does not preclude participation in any future Request for Proposals (if any) that may be issued. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the U.S Government to form a binding contract. This is not a solicitation announcement; this is a Request for Information (RFI) only. This Notice does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP); it does not guarantee the future issue of an RFP; nor does it commit the government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. Further, this Agency will not accept unsolicited proposals. Respondents are advised that this Agency will not pay for any information or administrative cost incurred in response to this Notice; all costs associated with responding to this Notice will be solely at the responding party's expense. At this time, proprietary information is not being requested, and respondents shall refrain from providing proprietary information in response to this Notice. Responses to this Notice will not be returned. Please be advised that all submissions become Government property and will not be returned. Not responding to this Notice does not preclude participation in any future RFP, if any is issued. In accordance with FAR 15.201(e), responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the U.S Government to form a binding contract. It is the responsibility of the interested parties to monitor this site for additional information pertaining to this Notice. GOVERNMENT REQUIREMENTS: The purpose of this project is to construct a full width ramp with a series of 31 weirs and pools. These weirs are designed as an upstream-pointing arch with side slopes which concentrate the flow towards the center of the channel. Further design elements include a 4-foot-wide V-notch in the weir and 1.5-foot diameter boulders emplaced on the weir. The 31st weir (upstream most weir) will be constructed entirely of concrete the intent is to protect the less robust rock emplacements by breaking up incoming ice. Construction of the fishway will involve partial demolition and excavation of the spillway and underlying bedrock to anchor the fishway to the rock and replace the existing spillway. On the downstream end of the fishway the existing channel will be removed for a length of 150 feet. A four foot-wide embedded low-flow channel in the center of the fishway has been designed to provide sufficient depth of water and flow during normal low flow conditions to allow fish passage. A series of parallel transverse rock ridges that consist of 1�6� foot diameter stones will be evenly spaced along the length of the ramp to provide a series of pools and falls. This low-flow channel and rock ridges are designed to allow for the passage of fish and other aquatic life would occur. Contract duration is estimated at 10 months. The estimated cost range is between $1,000,000.00 and $5,000,000.00. REQUESTED INFORMATION: This Agency requests that interested contractors complete the following questions to assist the government in its efforts. 1. Provide firm�s name and BUSINESS SIZE, Contractor�s Unique Entity Identifier (formerly DUNS Number) and CAGE Code, address, point of contact, phone number, and e-mail address. Contractors are REQUIRED to be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) AT THE TIME ITS BID IS SUBMITTED to comply with the annual representations and certifications requirements (Reference: FAR 4.1102(a)). 2. In consideration of North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 237990, with a small business size in dollars of $45.0M, which of the following small business categories is your business classified under, if any? Small Business, Service-Disabled, Veteran Owned Small Business, Small Disadvantaged Business, Woman-Owned Small Business, HUBZone Small Business, or 8(a) Small Business. 3. Describe the firm�s bonding capability. Is your firm capable of obtaining a performance and payment bond for a construction project valued between the project�s magnitude of costs? 4. Descriptions of Experience � Interested construction firms must provide no more than three (3) example projects with either greater than 95 percent completion or projects completed in the past five (5) years where the interested firm served as the prime contractor. Each project must include the name, title, project role, e-mail address, and telephone number of at least one reference. References may be used to verify project size, scope, dollar value, percentages, and quality of performance. Example projects must be of similar size and scope. NOTE: Total submittal package shall be no longer than 5 pages. Please only include a narrative of the requested information. SUBMISSION OF RESPONSES: Respondents interested in providing a response to this Notice shall provide their submittals to Andrew Hewitt prior to 3:30 p.m. Eastern Time on October 22, 2024, via email to: andrew.b.hewitt@usace.army.mil with copy to Jeffrey G. Ernest at Jeffrey.G.Ernest@usace.army.mil. In all correspondence, reference W912P425X11LG and Euclid Fishway Construction. Electronic files (EMAIL) CANNOT EXCEED this Agency's size limit of 20MB (includes email and its attachment); files exceeding this size will be denied access to email inbox. NEGATIVE REPLIES ARE WELCOMED. All interested sources must respond to future solicitation announcements separately from responses to this market survey.

Offerors shall demonstrate how they will comply with the following subfactors: Subfactor 1: Technical Capabilities: - Offeror shall submit a detailed technical approach demonstrating its ability to perform all requirements of the Performance Work Statement (PWS), including the full range of ground ambulance services required under the contract. - Offeror shall provide management and operational plans, including safety procedures, staffing, training, quality control, and transition/start-up timelines from contract award through full operational capability. - Offeror shall provide a contingency plan addressing staffing shortages, vehicle breakdowns, severe weather, communications failures, emergency evacuations, and continuity of operations. - Offeror shall demonstrate its capability to respond to multiple simultaneous emergency dispatches, peak workload periods, and installation training events while maintaining required response times. - Offeror shall demonstrate its ability to provide and sustain the required staffing, vehicles, equipment, and operational resources necessary to support continuous 24-hour, 7-day, 365-day emergency medical services. - Offeror shall demonstrate its understanding of and ability to comply with all applicable Federal, State of Louisiana, Department of Defense, DHA, Army EMS, OSHA, HIPAA, and other regulatory requirements governing contract performance. Subfactor 3: Vehicle and Equipment Maintenance - Offeror shall provide a comprehensive vehicle and equipment maintenance plan demonstrating how ambulances and medical equipment will be inspected, cleaned, tested, and maintained in accordance with manufacturer recommendations and applicable regulatory requirements. - Offeror shall demonstrate its capability to maintain continuous operational readiness through preventive maintenance, equipment inspections, inventory control, and timely replacement or repair of vehicles and medical equipment. - Offeror shall provide procedures for documenting vehicle inspections, equipment maintenance, corrective actions, and quality assurance activities to ensure uninterrupted mission support. - Offeror shall demonstrate its ability to maintain operational capability during vehicle or equipment failures through contingency planning and resource management in accordance with the Performance Work Statement. Subfactor 4: Quality Management and Performance Assurance - Offeror shall provide a Quality Control Plan (QCP) demonstrating how contract performance will be monitored to ensure compliance with all Performance Work Statement (PWS) requirements. - Offeror shall describe its quality management processes for identifying, documenting, correcting, and preventing recurring performance deficiencies throughout contract performance. - Offeror shall provide procedures for monitoring personnel qualifications, certifications, credentialing, mandatory training, and regulatory compliance to ensure continuous mission readiness. - Offeror shall provide a continuous quality improvement approach demonstrating how performance data, customer feedback, and operational trends will be used to improve service delivery and reduce performance risk. Performance must have been by the Offeror (not by a subsidiary or sister company) either as the prime contractor or subcontractor. Offerors shall complete and provide the Project Summary Sheet (Attachment 1) on three (3) task orders or stand-alone contracts/purchase orders the Offeror will complete or has completed within the past three (3) years from the closing date of this solicitation that the Offeror considers most relevant in demonstrating YOUR company's (the Offeror's) ability to perform the proposed effort. Past Performance must be with the Department of the Army, other US Government departments or agencies, state and local governments and/or commercial/private sector clients. If the Offeror performed as a subcontractor on the reference project, the Project Summary Sheet shall explain what percentage and type of work that was performed by the Offeror as subcontractor. In the instance that an offeror submits more than three (3) Project Summary Sheets, only the first three (3) will be evaluated. Offerors shall use the attachment provided. Past Performance Questionnaires (PPQs) (Attachment 2) may be submitted (however not required) for each past performance reference identified on the project summary sheet (Attachment 1). Contractor Performance Assessment Reports (CPARs) will also be accepted. For projects that have CPARs, Offerors can submit CPARs with Project Summary Sheets in lieu of PPQs. Offerors shall ensure CPARs are finalized and reference the exact same projects detailed in the Project Summary Sheet. If a PPQ or CPARs was not received for any of the past performance references identified on the project summary sheet, the Government may conduct interviews to validate performance/quality information. A past performance reference will not be evaluated if it does not contain valid/current POC contact information, or if the POC provided cannot validate work identified on the project summary sheet. title: NX EQ Combi Oven
description: The Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Non-Expendable Equipment National Program has identified the Combi Oven product line as a candidate for a VA-wide (otherwise referred to as �national�) Requirements contract. Combi Ovens are thermally insulated chambers used in cooking for warming, cooking, and baking food, typically fueled by either natural gas or electricity. Food service ovens have thermostatic controls, which turn the oven on and off and select the temperature at which the oven will operate, and, usually, a timer. Food service ovens may have complex, computer-based controls allowing a wide variety of operating modes. They may be freestanding or countertop units. The Contractor must demonstrate the ability to meet all requirements for the solicitation. The objective is to provide Combi Oven to be used by cooks within the VA medical centers and facilities, Continental United States (CONUS) and Outside the Continental United States (OCONUS). The period of performance is for a base of 12-months with four 12-month option periods. Please see the RFP and attachments for more information.

title: SOURCES SOUGHT-Motorized Precision Pan-Tilt Positioner-REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI)
description: The Naval Surface Warfare Center Carderock Division (NSWCCD) requires a motorized pan-tilt positioner, in accordance with attached minimum specifications, that will be utilized to mount sensing equipment such as cameras, calibration targets, weather equipment, etc., allowing the operational capability to pan and tilt the equipment remotely. This is a Request for Information (RFI)/Sources Sought notice only. This is not a request for proposals, and no contract will be awarded directly from this announcement. The information gathered will be used to support acquisition planning and determine the feasibility of various small business set-asides. Organizations with the potential capacity to provide the requested supply item are asked to submit a written Capability Statement containing the following information: 1. Company Information: Organization name, physical address, email address, website address, telephone number, and size and type of ownership for the organization. 2. Technical Capability Statement: Tailored capability statements addressing the particulars of this effort, with appropriate technical documentation (such as product datasheets) supporting claims of organizational and staff capability. 3. CAGE Code: Active Contractor and Government Entity (CAGE) Code. 4. Socio-Economic Business Size: Size of business (e.g., Large Business, Small Business, Small Disadvantaged, 8(a), HUBZone, Woman-Owned, and/or Veteran-Owned). title: APN - CETEMT New Facility and Compound, CFB Uplands
description: Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform the Design-Builder of an upcoming contract opportunity at CFB Uplands in Ottawa, Ontario. The purpose of this APN is to allow the Design-Builder to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested Design-Builders to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that this project will include an Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process.   Description of the Project and Services   This contract will provide the design and construction of the new facility and compound near the existing CETEMT (Counter Explosive Threat Equipment Management Team) compound at CFB Uplands. The new facility will be a single-storey building with an approximate footprint of 1,650 m2. It will include offices and workspaces, meeting rooms, maintenance garages and workshops, specialized spaces such as secure storage and a weapons vault, and support areas including a kitchenette, washrooms, and server rooms. The facility will be situated within a new exterior compound of approximately 6,500 m2, including parking areas.   The delivery method for this infrastructure will be a Modified Design-Build (MDB) contract. ROM estimate for the total value of the MDB contract is approximately $17M. It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND.   Contract Number: 88076 Title: CETEMT New Facility and Compound Approximate Estimate: $ 17M Anticipated Posting: Q4 FY26/27 Description: Provide the Counter Explosive Threat Equipment Management Team (CETEMT) a new facility and compound on CFB Uplands in Ottawa, Ontario according to operational requirements.   Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a Design-Builder will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated industrial security requirements of this project will be at FSC Secret. Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing Design-Builders  early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, Design-Builders that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential Design-Builders with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants or contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice); Contract number 88076; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the consultants or contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a consultant or contractor: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation (Contract number listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX, has  met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package, and has submitted a proposal or a bid DCC will  send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent or bidder regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent or bidder will need to promptly cooperate with CSP  to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca   Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Priscille Vumi Leader, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada 343-596-6289 Priscille.Vumi@dcc-cdc.gc.caBidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. description: *Please note that the ISC website will be available on September 23, 2026* This Challenge Notice is issued under the Innovative Solutions Canada Program (ISC) Call for Proposals 004 (EN578-24ISC4). For general ISC information, Offerors can visit the ISC website at: https://ised-isde.canada.ca/site/innovative-solutions-canada/en Please refer to the Solicitation Documents Innovative Solutions Canada Program Call for Proposals – 004 - Tender Notice | CanadaBuys https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities/tender-notice/cb-331-17030872 which contains the process for submitting a proposal. Phase 2: - The maximum funding available for any Phase 2 contract resulting from this Challenge is : $500,000.00 CAD excluding applicable taxes, shipping, travel and living expenses, as required. - The maximum duration for any Phase 2 contract resulting from this Challenge is up to 15 months (excluding submission of the final report). - Estimated number of Phase 2 contracts: 5 This disclosure is made in good faith and does not commit Canada to award any contract for the total approximate funding. Final decisions on the number of Phase 2 awards will be made by Canada on the basis of factors such as evaluation results, departmental priorities and availability of funds. Canada reserves the right to make partial awards and to negotiate project scope changes. Note: Selected companies are eligible to receive one contract per phase per challenge. Travel: Travel to Suffield, Alberta for prototype demonstration. Kick-off Meeting: All communication will take place by telephone or videoconference. Progress Review Meeting(s): Any progress review meetings will be conducted by telephone or videoconference. Final Review Meeting: All communication will take place by telephone or videoconference. Problem Statement: Challenge Statement Summary The challenge is to provide the Department of National Defense (DND) and the Canadian Army (CA) a software solution to provide an airspace common operating picture so that it can plan, deconflict, and control uncrewed aircraft system (UAS) traffic, including their use of the radio frequency (RF) spectrum, in order to ensure the safe and efficient management of UAS to enable the Canadian soldier to successfully fight and survive on the future battlefield. Details: Essential Outcomes The proposed solution must: 1. Be Windows-based. 2. Allow a user to create and store flight plans, including radio frequency requirements. 3. Have a flight plan repository (database) that stores the 4D (3D + time) trajectories and spectrum requirements of all accepted flight plans. 4. Enable integration of supplemental data services such as crewed aircraft flight plans and weather. 5. Generate an optimal 4D flight path for UAS based on specific mission goals and physical limits. 6. Be able to check new flight requests against existing flight plans, airspace constraints (no-fly zones) and RF spectrum requests to detect conflicts and resolve them (via set priorities or a human decision). 7. Generate 4D blocks of deconflicted airspace (a "tunnel" or a "box") where a UAS is permitted to fly. Additional Outcomes The proposed solution should: 1. Analyze real-time data from UASs to prevent collisions and automatically adjust flight paths for UASs in controlled airspace. 2. Check in real-time whether a UAS is following its pre-approved, deconflicted trajectory. 3. Demonstrate capacity in having its critical components produced and sourced in countries within the NATO alliance, NATO Partners or Major Non-NATO Allies. To achieve this, Offerors are requested to provide as an attachment to their proposal, a list identifying the solution's critical components, the country of production and sourcing for each component. Critical components and requested information for each Critical components are defined below: Critical components: 1. Radio 2. Ground control station (GCS) 3. On-board computer 4. Any software Requested information: i. Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM): Name of the original equipment manufacturer of the product being sourced ii. OEM URL: Provide the URL of the OEM iii. Software: Confirm if developed by Offeror or outsourced iv. Product name: Provide the OEM's product name v. Model number: Provide the OEM's model and/or version number of the product vi. Product URL: Provide the URL of the OEM product, model, and version vii. Country of origin IMPORTANT NOTE: For this challenge, kindly disregard the Attachment requirements detailed at Section D in the Web-Portal, and instead adhere to the following: - The attachment measures 8.5" by 11" with a maximum size of 10Mb. - Only the following formats will be accepted: JPG, GIF, TIF, PDF or PNG. - The attachment must be clear and legible. Note: Including an attachment is not mandatory, but forms part of the Additional Outcomes, which is scored up to 10 points. The Applicant (Offeror) acknowledges that it is within Canada's sole discretion to determine whether the attachment is removed or included in the Offer. Background & Context The CA is undergoing a generational modernization effort to address the evolving nature of technology, the changing character of conflict, and the unravelling of the geopolitical system. The transformative changes being made are conceptually described in the CA publication Inflection Point 2025. This document provides the broad context for modernization and directs the development and acquisition of key systems; in particular, it states: Key to this transformation is the integration of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, robotics, autonomous and uncrewed systems. These capabilities will support a wide range of functions, from intelligence analysis and predictive modeling to targeting and operational execution. The CA, in recognizing this need, has purchased foreign robotics and autonomous systems of varying quality and has identified challenges purchasing systems that meet operational requirements, in particular related to cold-weather operations, and that have stable supply chains. Further, purchases have, in the past, been constrained by limited manufacturing capacity of industry partners. To address this, the Government of Canada's recently released policy Canada's Defence Industrial Strategy, emphasizes the need to develop a strong domestic industrial capacity to produce defence materiel. This policy directs the CA to seek solutions to operational problems through Canadian industry, which will both improve the CA's capability while providing the foundation of a strong defence industrial base able to scale production of quality defence material. To date, engagements with Canadian industry have revealed a wide variety of small/medium companies that have commercial technologies that could, with support, be tailored to military requirements.

title: METAL PARTS
description: General Information This is a solicitation for non-commercial products prepared in accordance with the format in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR)/Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 13 as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Division (NSWC IHD), located in Indian Head, Maryland, intends to award a firm-fixed-price (FFP) purchase order using Simplified Acquisition Procedures METAL PARTS This solicitation will be competed as a total small business set-aside. Solicitation Details Quotes are being requested under Request for Quotations (RFQ) N0017426Q1123. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 332710 and the associated small business size standard is 500 employees. The solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through the FAR/RFO. This RFQ incorporates all provisions and clauses in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01 and the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) DPN 20260507. Technical Drawings If interested, technical drawings/CDRLS need to be requested by contractor prior to submission date. ITAR certification is required to be provided prior to technical drawing release. Drawing requests/CDRLS must be made via email to latrice.t.whitfield.civ@us.navy.mil by Friday, 16 OCTOBER 2026, 10:00 AM EST. Basis for Award The Government will award a purchase order resulting from this solicitation to the responsible vendor whose quote conforming to the solicitation will be most advantageous to the Government, price and other factors considered. The Government intends to evaluate all timely quotes received from eligible vendors on a Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA) basis. The Government intends to evaluate quotations and award a purchase order without discussion. Evaluation Factors: Technical: Quotes must reflect the required specifications and the exact brand specified in the Statement of Work. Price: Quotes must include all applicable costs, including shipping and handling. Netherlands – Endangered species protection services – Natuurvriendelijk isoleren (NVI) en een gebiedsdekkend (Pré) Soortenmanagementplan (SMP)
description: Gemeente Beekdaelen beoogt met deze aanbestedingsprocedure een gebiedsdekkend soortenmanagementplan (SMP), een pré-SMP en de uitvoering van natuurvriendelijk isoleren (NVI) te verwerven, inclusief begeleiding van de bijbehorende aanvragen omgevingsvergunning flora- en fauna activiteit bij het bevoegd gezag. Gemeente Beekdaelen beoogt met deze aanbestedingsprocedure een gebiedsdekkend soortenmanagementplan (SMP), een pré-SMP en de uitvoering van natuurvriendelijk isoleren (NVI) te verwerven, inclusief begeleiding van de bijbehorende aanvragen omgevingsvergunning flora- en fauna activiteit bij het bevoegd gezag. De opdracht bestaat uit één overeenkomst voor de ontwikkeling van drie onderdelen. 1. Het uitvoeren van de opdracht Natuurvriendelijk isoleren voor gemeente Beekdaelen; 2. Het ontwikkelen van een Pré-Soortenmangementplan, inclusief het verzorgen en begeleiden van de bijbehorende aanvraagprocedure voor een (tijdelijke) omgevingsvergunning voor een flora- en faunactiviteit bij het bevoegd gezag en ondersteuning bij eventuele bezwaar- en beroepsprocedures voor Gemeente Beekdaelen; 3. Het ontwikkelen van een gebiedsdekkend SMP, inclusief het verzorgen en begeleiden van de bijbehorende aanvraagprocedure voor een gebiedsgerichte omgevingsvergunning flora- en fauna-activiteit bij het bevoegd gezag en ondersteuning bij eventuele bezwaar- en beroepsprocedures voor de gemeente Beekdaelen. Beekdaelen telt ongeveer 35.903 inwoners met ongeveer 16.915 woningen. Hiervan zijn 72,8% koopwoningen. Gemeente Beekdaelen heeft een totale oppervlakte van 7.840 hectare en de gemiddelde dichtheid van de adressen is 508 adressen per km2. Het onderzoek richt zich op het bebouwde gebied. Dit bedraagt ongeveer 12.6 km². Het onderzoeksgebied dient als basis voor de prijsvorming. Het definitieve onderzoeksgebied zal in samenspraak met de Provincie Limburg moeten worden vastgesteld gedurende de eerste fase van de opdracht. Gemeente Beekdaelen wenst binnen drie jaar na opdrachtverstrekking het NVI te hebben voltooid en te beschikken over een goed werkend SMP, inclusief een gebiedsgerichte omgevingsvergunning.

title: FCI Elkton - Upgrade Fire Pump
description: The Federal Bureau of Prisons (FBOP), Federal Correctional Institution (FCI) Elkton, anticipates the issuance of a solicitation for the award of a firm-fixed-price construction contract for a project titled Upgrade Fire Pump for FCI Elkton located 8730 Scroggs Road, Lisbon, OH 44432. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation prepared in accordance with the format in subpart FAR Revision Subpart 12.2, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes as the only solicitation; quotes are being requested and a written solicitation is issued (see attached). You are required to provide all pages of the written attached solicitation with your complete quotation. Solicitation Number: 15BBNF26Q21600002 and is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) A statement that the solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular 2026-1, Effective Date March 13, 2026. This is a 100 percent small business set-aside. You must be registered in www.sam.gov as a small business for the applicable NAICS code. (see FAR Provision 52.219-1 in the Representations and Certifications section of your sam.gov registration). The Period of Performance for this project will be 181 Calendar Days from the issuance of the Notice to Proceed. The provision at 52.212-1, Instructions to Offerors-Commercial Products and Commercial Services, applies to this acquisition and a statement regarding any addenda to the provision. All quotes will be evaluated based on price, technical capability, and past performance. Clause at 52.212-4, Contract Terms and Conditions-Commercial Products and Commercial Services, applies to this acquisition. SCOPE OF WORK: The contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, tools, and incidentals necessary to remove the existing diesel fire pump controller and associated components and furnish and install a new UL?listed diesel fire pump controller in a NEMA 4/4X enclosure. Work includes demolition of obsolete battery racks, conduit, and wiring; installation of new underground conduit and communication lines; reconnection of engine control circuits, sensors, and dual?battery systems; and integration with the facility�s Siemens DDC and Desigo CC automation platforms. All work must be performed in compliance with NFPA 20, applicable Federal, State, and local codes, and Bureau of Prisons technical requirements. Commissioning will include hydrostatic testing, flow/no?flow testing, controller functional checks, and alarm/signal verification. See the attached Statement of Work and Drawings for complete technical specifications. The estimated magnitude of the project is between $250,000 and $500,000. title: APN - REPLACEMENT OF AIRFIELD LIGHTING POWER CENTRE (ALPC)
description: Advance Procurement Notice REPLACEMENT OF AIRFIELD LIGHTING POWER CENTRE (ALPC) 4 WING COLD LAKE, ALBERTA (with Security Requirements) Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at 4 Wing Cold Lake, Alberta. The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Description of the Project and Services 4 Wing Cold Lake, Alberta requires replacement of the existing Airfield Lighting Power Centre (ALPC) building with a new ALPC building. The project will improve the reliability and efficiency of electrical power supplied to the Airfield Lighting System and support continuous flying operations.  The new system will supply power to new LED airfield lighting systems planned for installation over a five-year period starting in 2027. The existing ALPC will continue to power the existing incandescent lighting system until those systems have been replaced with LED systems.  The Department of National Defence intends to retain a contractor for work including, but not necessarily limited to, the following:  Civil and site preparation work, including concrete pads, slabs and footings for the building and fuel tank; extension of airfield lighting circuits to the new location; and design and construction of the new ALPC facility, including equipment, controls and lighting-control software.  Removal of the existing approximately 63.7 m² ALPC building, including its foundation, fuel tank and power systems, after the new building and power systems have been installed and commissioned.  Supply and installation of a new, approximately 100 m², prefabricated steel ALPC building configured in two sections: an airfield regulator section and a generator section.  Precast concrete manholes, airfield series lighting cable, and concrete-encased direct-buried electrical services.  Associated airfield electrical work performed by journeyperson airfield electricians in accordance with CSA Z463-18.  It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND. Contract Number: 88023  Title: Replacement of Airfield Lighting Power Centre (ALPC)  Approximate Estimate: $11,100,000  Anticipated Posting: Fall 2026  Description: Design and construction of a new ALPC facility and associated civil, electrical, airfield lighting, controls, generator, fuel system, commissioning and removal work at 4 Wing Cold Lake Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a bidder will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS). Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors that intend to submit a bid for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential bidders with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants or contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice); Contract number 88023; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the consultants or contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a contractor: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation (Contract number listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package, and has submitted a bid DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the bidder regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the bidder will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Gerry Melake Coordinator, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada 306-821-2225 Gerry.Melake@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process and does not provide any representations or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the bidder agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the bidder for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sponsorship process.  Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. title: Germany – Software supply services – TWD Procurement Suite
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Bereitstellung, Implementierung und der Betrieb einer integrierten, cloudbasierten Procurement Suite zur Unterstützung der Beschaffungs- und Lieferantenmanagementprozesse im Konzern der Technischen Werke Dresden GmbH (TWD). Die Lösung soll als standardisierte SaaS-Anwendung eines Herstellers bereitgestellt werden und eine einheitliche Plattform für die Digitalisierung, Standardisierung und effiziente Steuerung der Beschaffungsprozesse schaffen. Im Rahmen der ersten Einführungswelle umfasst der Leistungsumfang die Funktionen des Supplier Relationship Managements (SRM) sowie das Katalogmanagement und die Abwicklung von Katalogbestellungen. Die Lösung soll eine durchgängige Unterstützung der Prozesse von der Lieferantenregistrierung über Qualifizierung, Bewertung und Risikobetrachtung bis hin zur Bestellung aus freigegebenen Katalogen ermöglichen. Darüber hinaus soll die angebotene Suite die Grundlage für einen späteren Ausbau weiterer Beschaffungsfunktionen bilden. Hierzu zählen insbesondere Funktionen des Source-to-Contract (S2C), weitere Procure-to-Pay-(P2P)-Prozesse sowie Guided Buying. Ziel ist die langfristige Etablierung einer integrierten, zukunftsfähigen und weitgehend standardnahen Procurement-Plattform mit einer gemeinsamen Datenbasis, einer einheitlichen Benutzeroberfläche und einem konsistenten Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzept. Der Auftraggeber verfolgt dabei ausdrücklich das Prinzip „Standard vor Individualisierung“. Individuelle Entwicklungen sollen auf das fachlich und technisch notwendige Minimum beschränkt werden, um eine hohe Releasefähigkeit, geringe Betriebskosten und eine nachhaltige Weiterentwicklung der Lösung sicherzustellen.

title: Pyrophoric Device Demonstration
description: The Department of War (DoW) Joint Services (US Navy, US Marine Corps, Army, Air Force, Special Operations Command (SOCOM) and Air Force Special Operations Command (AFSOC)) require an expendable pyrophoric countermeasure to use independently or in conjunction with both onboard and offboard countermeasures. The DoW has a need to develop a new source for this crucial countermeasure capability. One of the primary missions of the Platform Protection & Countermeasures Technologies Division (WXR) is to develop countermeasures to protect U.S. aircraft from threat missile systems. Expendable Countermeasures have been utilized to protect U.S. aircraft against surface-to-air and air-to-air threats since as early as the 1960s. Once the presence of a missile is indicated, a pilot releases an expendable countermeasure in an attempt to decoy the missile. The countermeasure and countermeasure techniques are designed to confuse the missile seeker and its counter-countermeasure logic, ultimately causing it to decoy away from aircraft. Expendable countermeasures are part of a multi-layer approach to protect aircraft from enemy threat missiles. In their simplest form, the concept of expendable countermeasures is to provide a decoy that is �more attractive� than the aircraft being protected, thereby pulling the threat missile�s targeting system away from the aircraft and towards the decoy. In total, any mechanism by which the expendable interferes with the missile�s targeting system sufficiently to make it miss the aircraft is a success. This effort is in response to finding a new supplier of pyrophoric countermeasures. Pyrophoric countermeasures (M211, MJU-49/B, MJU-64/B, MJU-66/B, XM219, MJU-50A/B, MJU-51A/B, & MJU-52A/B) remain an active part of IR threat protection systems offering the best solution for the Joint Services to counter legacy and advanced IR missile threats.
